description: Hooks gate only sessions launched with APPA_GATE=1 (the clappa alias). The guard reads the Claude Code process environment, fixed at launch, so a session cannot ungate itself. Without the variable every hook exits 0 and SessionStart prints beta-announcement.md instead of the gate context — a one-line invitation to try clappa — or, when the runtime binary is not installed, setup-appa.md: instructions for the model to offer and perform the install as a prompted task, prefixed with the resolved install target so the instructions and the gate's binary lookup cannot disagree on the path. In a gated session every hook posts its event to the appa-runtime-v2 process and prints the runtime's answer. SessionStart first runs ensure-runtime.sh, which starts the installed runtime when nothing healthy answers /health. curl --fail-with-body exits non-zero on a non-2xx answer and on a connection failure; plain curl exits 0 on server errors and would fail open. The trailing exit 2 makes every failure the blocking hook outcome: no answer from the runtime blocks the action. SessionStart itself cannot block the session; the UserPromptSubmit gate blocks the first prompt instead. The 120-second deadline outlasts the runtime's own evidence round trips; a hook that still times out blocks, never passes. The context hook is advice, not enforcement, so its failure does not block.

hooks.command: [ "${APPA_GATE:-}" = 1 ] || exit 0; sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/ensure-runtime.sh" </dev/null && curl --fail-with-body -sS -m 120 -X POST "${APPA_RUNTIME_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8787}/hook" -H 'content-type: application/json' --data-binary @- || exit 2

if [ "${APPA_GATE:-}" = 1 ]; then cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-context.md"; elif [ -x "${APPA_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/appa-runtime-v2" ] || command -v appa-runtime-v2 >/dev/null 2>&1; then cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/beta-announcement.md"; else printf 'Install target for this machine: %s
Plugin files: %s

' "${APPA_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/appa-runtime-v2" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/setup-appa.md"; fi
